content:
We need to find a template that when applied retrosynthetically (i.e., forward reaction is HWE) matches the target molecule. The task: return mapped_rxn associated with the template that, when applied to the molecule, reproduces the reaction. We have precursors from previous step (make_5_lvl2-apply_template-1) which gave three possible precursor pairs. Those are likely the result of applying a template. We need to find which template was used (template_id) and its mapped_rxn.

Thus we need to search template catalog by criteria: functional groups broken/formed etc. But the tool expects specific functional group names from list. For HWE, broken groups: C-P (phosphonate) and C-O (maybe carbonyl? Actually carbonyl oxygen? The reaction breaks C-P bond and C-O bond (the O of the phosphonate?). The formed groups: aliphatic carboxylic acid (product) and C-C double bond (alkene). The functional groups list includes "aliphatic carboxylic acid", "C-C double bonds". For broken groups, maybe "phosphonate" not in list. Could be "phosphonate" not available. So we may not need to specify broken groups. We can search by formed groups only.

Also bonds formed/broken need numeric atom indices, not helpful.

Thus maybe we can search by functional_groups_formed only.

Let's try search with functional_groups_formed only.
